project_description: 5-storey commercial office building in BGC, Makati. Total built-up area of 25,000 sqm across 5 floors (5,000 sqm per floor). Site area is 5,000 sqm with basement level for parking. The project includes Class A office spaces, modern lobby, conference rooms, and rooftop garden. Timeline: 18 months (approximately 64 weeks) from mobilization to turnover. Project type: Premium Commercial Real Estate Development with LEED certification requirements.
boq_text: Foundation: Pile driving with 1,200mm bored piles (250 piles total). Ground floor concrete slab (2,500 cubic meters). Concrete works total: 8,500 cubic meters ready-mix concrete. Structural Steel: 2,800 metric tons of structural grade steel. Reinforcement: 450 metric tons of rebar and mesh. Masonry: 450,000 pieces of hollow blocks, 50,000 units of wall tiles. Carpentry: Extensive formworks, scaffolding, and templets. Waterproofing: 15,000 sqm of high-grade membrane and coatings. Electrical: 150 kV distribution system, 500 distribution panels, 15 km of electrical conduits. Plumbing: Hot and cold water system with storage capacity 500 cubic meters. Fire Protection: Sprinkler system with 2,000 sprinkler heads. HVAC: Central air conditioning system with chiller capacity 500 tons. Fireproofing: Intumescent paint on all structural steel members.
plans_text: Architectural Design: 5-storey structure with regular grid layout. Typical floor dimensions: 100m x 50m. Ground floor: 1,500 sqm lobby, 2,500 sqm retail space, 1,000 sqm amenities. Levels 2-5: 4,500 sqm leasable office space per floor. Basement: 3,000 sqm parking with 150 slots. Roof: 1,000 sqm garden and equipment area. Building height: 25 meters total. Column spacing: 8m x 10m grid. Floor-to-floor height: 4.2 meters. Structural system: Reinforced concrete with structural steel frame.
schedule_text: Phase 1 - Site Preparation (Weeks 1-2): Mobilization, site clearing, utility disconnection. Phase 2 - Foundation (Weeks 3-10): Excavation, piling, ground floor concrete, basement construction. Phase 3 - Structural Frame - Lower Levels (Weeks 11-20): Formwork, rebar installation, concrete placement for levels 1-3, structural steel erection. Phase 4 - Structural Frame - Upper Levels (Weeks 21-30): Formwork, rebar, concrete for levels 4-5, roof construction. Phase 5 - Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (Weeks 31-50): Roughing-in of all MEP systems, installation of major equipment, testing. Phase 6 - Interior Finishes (Weeks 51-60): Drywall, painting, flooring, ceiling installation, door and window installation. Phase 7 - Final Finishes & Commissioning (Weeks 61-64): Tile work, fixture installation, punch list, final inspections, LEED compliance verification.
other_docs: Project Budget: ₱2.5 Billion total project cost. Labor budget allocation: 18% (₱450M). Contract type: Design-Build with performance specifications. Client: Major Real Estate Development Corporation. Consultant: International Architecture & Engineering Firm. Contractor: Top-tier construction company with experience in high-rise commercial projects. LEED Target: LEED Gold Certification. Environmental: EIA approved, waste management plan in place, dust control required. Safety: DOLE compliance mandatory, 24/7 on-site safety officer required.
